title: APS 2.8.2.18 Sprit distance timestamp error in the timer
symptom: There is a periodic error in the timer when bolusing meals via the bolus suggestion calculator with a syringe interval. Carbohydrates were triggered with an interval of 10 minutes, in the timer these 10 minutes were not set but only 1 minute. In the APS main screen and treatment tab everything was booked and set correctly. Only affects the timer for the carbohydrate intake.
cause: The issue is with having a `Long` passed as time instead of an `Int`.
fix: The fix is provided by a PR that changes the datatype from `Long` to `Int` for the timer.
evidence_quote: I guess the issue is with having a`Long` passed as time instead of an `Int`. I'll PR a possible fix in the course of the day.
